en.welcome_text: Keep your service history together and see what needs attention.
en.local_note: Your history stays on this phone. No account needed.
en.name_label: Make, model or your own name
en.config_help: You can keep a history even if the engine or gearbox code is unknown.
en.recalculate_demo: Deadlines are calculated in the app · demo
en.no_schedule_text: We do not have a verified schedule for this vehicle variant. Your history is still available.
en.missing_text: Add the last completed service. Missing documents do not mean the service was missed.
en.stale_title: Is your odometer up to date?
en.stale_text: Last recorded 10 Aug 2026. Distance estimates use this reading.
en.offline_text: History and on-device document reading still work. A new schedule cannot be fetched now.
en.invalid_source_text: The schedule is no longer verified for this car. New manufacturer deadlines need a fresh check.
en.custom_source: Custom sample interval: 12,000 km / 12 months. This is not a manufacturer recommendation.
en.source_demo_text: Fictional source DEMO-SOURCE v1. Shows how a checked source would be presented. No real manufacturer data.
en.interval_help: A custom interval is your choice, not a recommendation from the manufacturer.
en.interval_saved: Demo: custom interval shown. No calculation was run.
en.drafts: Drafts are separate from completed services.
en.older_reading: This older reading will not replace the current odometer reading.
en.service_saved: Demo: one service added to this view. Nothing was stored.
en.import_help: Image or PDF · up to 20 MB and 20 pages.
en.on_device: The document is read on your phone. You check the result before saving.
en.preview_note: Fictional excerpt. The app will show the original invoice here.
en.unreadable_title: The text is hard to read
en.unreadable_text: Try a clearer image or add the service manually.
en.duplicate_text: Open the existing document to avoid recording it twice.
en.wrong_car_title: This may be for another car
en.wrong_car_text: Check the vehicle identification before anything is added to history.
en.encrypted_text: Choose an unlocked copy or a photo of the document.
en.large_text: Choose a file of up to 20 MB and 20 pages.
en.cancelled_text: No service was recorded. You can try again.
en.review_help: This is a draft. Compare it with the document and correct any mistakes.
en.quote_notice: This does not confirm completed service. It does not change service deadlines.
en.discard_text: You can keep the draft or discard it. No service has been saved.
en.draft_kept: Demo: draft kept in memory, not stored on the phone.
en.reminder_help: Optional. This demo does not request system permission.
en.export_text: An export may contain private documents. In the app, you choose where to save it.
en.restore_text: The app checks file version, contents and duplicates before changing data. No real file is read in this demo.
en.delete_text: Cars, history, documents and reminders will be removed. Previously exported files are not affected.
en.no_file_created: Demo: no file was created or read.
en.delete_done: The demo was reset. No real data was deleted.
en.update_note: Example: 59,000 km. This is a demonstration, not live mileage.
en.reading_saved: Demo: reading updated in this view. No data was stored.
en.privacy_text: This prototype sends no documents and stores nothing. The app privacy policy will describe its actual data flows and SDKs.
en.validation_date: Choose a valid date that is not in the future.
en.validation_odo: Odometer must be a non-negative whole number, or left empty.
en.validation_actions: Choose at least one completed action.
en.validation_interval: Enter a positive distance or month interval.
